# Process Discovery Notes

**Use it when:** somebody has asked you to automate something you have not watched yet.
**It exists to stop:** building a tool that replaces a workaround nobody explained to you.

> *The workaround IS the requirements document. Somebody already solved the problem
> badly-but-correctly, and every quirk in their process encodes a real constraint.*

---

## The workarounds people have already built

## Exceptions and edge cases

The ones that will decide whether this ships. Ask "when does this go wrong?" three
times before you stop writing.

## What must stay human

Name it explicitly, now, in front of the client. Anything involving judgment,
liability, money moving, or a relationship is a candidate.
